name: Trapdoor
description: It carries the door. A disc of packed earth and silk sits on the cephalothorax with a dark rim and a grain of grit over it, so the body reads as squat and lidded from above — the one cave spider that is wider than it is long. Everything else on it is built for one movement: short thick legs braced under the mass and two long fangs with lit tips, which are the only bright thing on it because the part that is cocked is the part that should be read. No elite art on purpose — this one only ever arrives as a squad, and the marking is drawn from the wave table. Gameplay radius 12.

wait.description: a short, braced gait that never quite settles: the legs step, the lid on its back holds still, and the two ember tips shiver against the catch — the whole body is a thing being held shut
